Real use cases

Multilingual dubbing Generate narration across a wide range of supported languages.

Bottom line

ElevenLabs' voice quality is convincing enough that we'd genuinely recommend a disclosure disclaimer when you use cloned voices — that's the best compliment we can pay a voice tool. The free tier's character limit is low, so budget for a paid plan quickly if you're doing anything beyond a quick test.

Frequently asked questions

Is ElevenLabs free to use?

There's a limited free tier; regular use requires a paid plan starting around $5/mo.

Can ElevenLabs clone my voice?

Yes, voice cloning is one of its core features.

How many languages does ElevenLabs support?

A wide range — check the current site for the full supported list.

Does ElevenLabs have an API?

Yes, API access is available for integrating narration into other products.

Is ElevenLabs good for audiobooks?

Yes, narration quality is strong enough for many audiobook and video use cases.

When was ElevenLabs last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-06-30.
